lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regularized 2D grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with approximately 4-5 spots visible per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spots to form a coordinate-like grid pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant V-shaped indentation or amputation on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) clustered around the ventral-pectoral junction.
